asset_manifest.pose: dino_bones_paleontologist_1 (female grad student, blonde hair, pink blouse) stands over a trackway in white limestone silt, holding a camera to document the tracks.

visual_notes.ichnology: The tracks are asymmetrical. The hand prints (manus) are shallow, three-fingered V-shapes pointing outward. The rear footprints are slender and plantigrade. Ensure deep shadow within the negative impressions to show depth against the high-albedo white sand.
visual_notes.ground: Fine-grained white carbonate silt with soft water-ripple marks.
